Remote Phonebook

Lost your phone, or the battery died? Dial *384*88041# from any phone, even a basic one with no internet, and your contacts are there. Organisations put the right contacts, notices and reminders in every member's phone book.

What it does

Your phone book, safe and reachable from anywhere

Works on any phone

USSD works on every phone in Kenya, from a kabambe to the newest smartphone.

No internet needed

Dial the code and your contacts are there. No data bundle, no app download.

For organisations

Schools, SACCOs, companies, law firms and insurers put the right contacts, notices and reminders in every member's phone book.

On every channel

USSD on any phone, the Android app, the website and an organisation platform. The iPhone app is coming soon.
